# NextPhases

> Software development company based in Lusaka, Zambia. We build websites, mobile apps, custom software systems, and technical consulting for businesses in Zambia, Africa, the UK, and internationally.

## Company

NextPhases is founded and led by a team of four co-founders:

- **Thuma** – Co-Founder, CTO & CMO
- **Simon** – Co-Founder, COO
- **Christian** – Co-Founder, CEO & Chief Commercial Officer
- **Shaun** – Co-Founder, VP Engineering

Our team combines expertise in architecture, operations, leadership, and engineering to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions. We also have contributors like **Lans**, a developer supporting active development across NextPhases projects.

## Team Roles

- **Thuma (CTO & CMO)** – Sets technical direction and brand strategy. Leads architecture, development strategy, and company communications. Expert in modern web technologies (React, Node.js, Python) and system design.

- **Simon (COO)** – Manages operations, project delivery, and client communication. Ensures projects move from kickoff to launch without losing momentum.

- **Christian (CEO & CCO)** – Leads company vision, manages client relationships, and drives commercial growth. Handles company voice and strategic partnerships.

- **Shaun (VP Engineering)** – Guides engineering quality and implementation standards. Ensures every shipped feature feels dependable and polished.

- **Lans (Developer Contributor)** – Supports development work across NextPhases projects while building hands-on experience with real clients.

## Services

- Web Development: business websites, landing pages, web applications, e-commerce, performance optimization
- App Development: Android, iOS, cross-platform mobile apps, web apps, internal tools
- Technical Consulting: tech stack selection, digital transformation, architecture planning, security
- Custom Software: dashboards, automation systems, business management tools, SaaS products

## Products

- Nsolo: a digital adaptation of a traditional Zambian mancala-style board game
- ExamGuard: exam management and invigilation platform for schools and universities

## Pricing

Regional pricing model. ZMW for Zambia. ZAR for South Africa. GBP/EUR for UK/Europe. USD for US, Canada, and international. Contact for a quote.
